arguments.body: The original outline we should preserve is a progression: establish the original signal, lay out the hypothesis stack, then show the week-by-week rule-out cadence. From there, explain the onboarding-trigger A/B design and why we waited for the stabilization cohort before calling a result; only then introduce the mid-segment cohort redefinition (50–200 to 75–200 seats), followed by a short reusable framework section. Keep the causal path legible rather than turning this into a milestone-by-milestone chronology. Priya was the original review partner.
